elements.label: Chat conversation column (tool rows: Read/Write, Plan, write_file, Progress 5/5, player.jsx, profile.jsx) scrolling up out of view
Verifier tool row arriving at the top of the view
Claude's answer starting to stream in

sfx_review.label: music
sfx_review.note: One of a regular series of broadband percussive hits (about 31.70, 31.88, 32.00, 32.27s) in the score, before the scroll starts; a beat, not a dedicated impact.

sfx_review.label: music
sfx_review.note: Rhythmic score texture after the scroll settles; no visual hit at that moment.

pattern.description: The chat transcript scrolls up quickly past the completed tool steps and the Progress 5/5 checklist, settling on the Verifier row as Claude's answer begins streaming below it.
pattern.why_premium: Compresses a long agent run into one fast eased scroll: the viewer sees the stack of completed steps fly by, which reads as work done, and the motion lands exactly where the answer starts, so the next beat starts without a cut.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.to('.chat-scroll', {y: -scrollDistance, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power2.inOut'}); then gsap.from('.answer .word', {opacity: 0, duration: 0.08, stagger: 0.06, ease: 'none'}) starting at the scroll end.
build_hint.remotion: translateY = -scrollDistance * interpolate(frame, [0, 9], [0, 1], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); answer words revealed by index with Math.floor((frame - 9) / 1.5) for a word-by-word stream.

notes: Code reports camera.move tilt_down (whole frame shifts, pan_y -1.40), so this may be a camera tilt over a static long UI rather than an in-panel scroll; the visible result is the same. Several end-frame diff boxes (b03-b09, b11-b13) are blank areas where earlier rows used to be and are not listed.
